body:
pyro1488@my-deja.com
   Message 1 of 1
Leftist Masochism

*~"Notice the masochistic tendency of leftist tactics. Leftists
protest by lying down in front of vehicles, they intentionally
provoke police or racists to abuse them, etc. These tactics may
often be effective, but many leftists use them not as a means to
an end but because they PREFER masochistic tactics. Self-hatred
is a leftist trait." (Paragraph 20)
--T. Kaczynski~*

-We may find something worthwhile in here, and I almost agree
with TK here. But what else does he suppose as a counter-attack?
There is not much left (if you're one of those leftist sissys who
do not dream of killing your enemies more brutally than they
would like to kill you).

*~A while back I made a post about Stephen Donaldson, the founder
of Stop Prisoner Rape, and described his experience behind bars
after being arrested for protesting the Vietnam War. Well, the
ACLU, left wing activists, and friends of his have made him into
a hero. Well, I think he was a punk -- and nothing more than
that.*~

-Pyro, you really don't know what you're talking about. It may be
nothing but a MTV-fashion nowadays, but it once was damn
rebellious to be nothing but a punk. There was a time time when
it meant something, and Donny the Punk surely belonged to that
time.
I know him personally from a time when I went to NY, and he put
me up like it was considered normal among punks back then. (No,
he did not try to fuck me; I didn't care about his sexual
preferences, and he didn't care about mine. That's what makes us
different from people like you; we can respect each other even
without agreeing on everything which is up to oneself.)

*~I think the heroes were those brave soldiers who fought and
died for our country.~*

-Then why were you not one of them? There are not many Jews in
Vietnam, but it sure was a nice opportunity to kill some of those
subhumans (Who did win the war in the end - and nowadays see the
Americans as one factor among those masses of foreign invaders
who were defeated).

*~The average age of our troops was 19; these were kids! At one
point 100 were dying a day. What was Jane Fonda doing? Sitting on
her fat leftist arse reaping the rewards of capitalism and waving
a Viet Cong flag while they were fighting and dying. I saw the
public broadcasting special, "Dear America: Letters from Vietnam"
and was deeply inspired;
I felt pride in our country, right or wrong I admired to valor of
the soldiers.*~

-Right or wrong, these were  people in the same spirit who fought
against the Nazis. Why didn't you join them? Afraid? Too young?
Too old? Too useless? Can't you see this just as one bad mistake
of the US government? These 19-year-olds were not heroes, they
were just victims. And I have compassion for them, even if it
makes me one of those sissy leftists.

*~To think of those cowardly reprobates, being priveleged college
kids who evaded the draft, spitting on our soldiers (many of whom
were black and hispanic) upon their return makes me sick.
Stephen Donaldson was not a hero, he was a punk. A weak suburban
white punk.*~

-Maybe, but if you would know anything about Punk you would know
why this was not insulting. We see it as a kind of honour not to
be a dead hero, but rather be a living example for other people
who are afraid to be themselves. What do YOU have except your
pathological hatred for the Jews? I still have much respect for
Donny (RIP), but you still have to work hard to earn my respect.
Donny was sincere; he did not feel ashamed for what was done to
him, he was a victim who knew how to FIGHT BACK.

*~It was easy for him to protest a war, but would he have been
willing to fight and die for anything? Well, one thing I know for
sure, he wasn't willing to fight for his manhood while he was
incarcerated. He was repeatedly raped behind bars, unwilling or
unable to at least ATTEMPT to defend himself. Moreover, while he
was getting violated he felt that he was paying for the sins of
society; he felt he deserved it!*~

-Too much bullshit here to reject every item. He told me that he
was raped while being high on a very big dosage of LSD, and I
wonder what you would have done in that situation. Fight for the
Aryans? Pyro, just try to think for a very short time, and tell
me what you would have done better in that situation. Shit, I
admit I miss him. He would have known how to defend himself.

*~Here he shows his self-hate and mental weakness:
"There were times when I felt like I was paying for all the sins
of the white race."
Here he describes the racially seething atmosphere in prison:
"Some guys were really, ah, were really rough, and they'd make
racial comments, for example, 'Your ass belongs to the black man.
Don't you ever forget it.' Stuff like that, you know."
I think there are many more Steven Donaldsons in our society; Ted
Kaczynski described it as a disease. TK took a major detour in
the beginning of the Manifesto just to talk about it. These types
are sheep; they will rarely, if ever, challenge any fundamental
beliefs of society but will latch onto already accepted beliefs
and gripe about people not following them enough. They will do
this under ANY system because they not only blithely follow the
the status quo, but worse, they are oversocialized COWARDS.*~

-Cowards? This guy was doing time for attempting to murder a cop
when you were just figuring out which Jew to hate most. We Punks
can beat you anytime; we are not afraid. And we do not believe
this hero-shit anymore.

*~Being politically correct is NOT REBELLIOUS; it is conformity.
It is fighting to preserve and enforce values which are already
ingrained in our society. *~

-Right. But attacking everything which is pc is not rebellious,
either. It just becomes BORING. Everybody does that. Think of
something else.
Pyro, please be so honest to tell me from where you got all your
information about Stephen Donaldson.
You would climb 2 steps in my imaginary evolutionary ladder if
you would just provide me with that information.

Mowhak
(wouldn't life be boring w/out enemies?)
